messages:
anika: flagging an incident - several tenants saw SCIM backlog + SAML login failures after the KMS grant cleanup job ran at 04:03 UTC. Provisioner started returning 500s and queuing requests.

anika: snippet from provisioner logs:
```
2026-04-01T04:05:12Z ERROR scim/provisioner.go:198 failed to decrypt service_token: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd1234
tenant=papertrail req=6b7c8d
```

ben: which KMS key/alias? did key policy or grants change?

maria: the cleanup job removed temporary grants that had been created for onboarding tests. It looks like one grant was still in use by the provisioning service account. The grant revocation removed the principal from the key, not the IAM policy.

infra-bot: automated note: scheduled job `kms-grant-prune` ran 2026-04-01T04:03:00Z. Affected grants: 17.

sre-oncall: consequence: provisioner cannot decrypt stored extid tokens -> 500s -> SCIM queue growth -> failed deprovision/enroll operations. We need a quick unblock: re-create a scoped grant for the service account or rewrap tokens with a key the service account can access.

anika: mitigation done: re-created a grant for svcacc:infra-scim-provisioner with constraints limiting usage to decrypt only; restarted pods. Decrypts resumed.

ben: scan CloudTrail for GrantRevoke events and Decrypt denies between 04:00-04:15 to enumerate impacted tenants. Command I ran: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RevokeGrant --start-time 2026-04-01T04:00:00Z --end-time 2026-04-01T04:15:00Z`.

maria: found 12 tenants with transient failures, queue backlog peaked at ~480 pending ops. Backfill is in progress; we are throttling to avoid IdP rate limits.

vuln-triage: note - during triage we discovered a stale service account (svcacc:onboard-broker) that had an existing long-lived grant on the same key. That account is not in our inventory and violates least-privilege. Marking for vuln triage.

anika: created SEC ticket SEC-2026-078 for the stale grant and service account audit. Short term: we revoked the stale grant after ensuring no active use; long term: plan to rotate keys and rewrap extids.

maria: post-incident actions: 1) add guardrail to kms-grant-prune to skip grants tagged `in-use-by=infra-scim-provisioner`, 2) add CloudTrail query to rotation runbook to verify no active grants removed, 3) add telemetry: `scim.decrypt.denied_by_grantrevocation` metric and dashboard.

ben: also add an enforcement check in infra-repo CI to flag long-lived grants >30d and orphaned svcaccs. Vulnerability team to follow up on orphaned svcacc.

sre-oncall: created suppression for pager while backfill runs. Will re-enable if errors persist.

anika: backfill command: `./bin/scim-backfill --window 2026-04-01T03:50:00Z,2026-04-01T05:00:00Z --concurrency 10` - currently processing, 312/480 completed.

vuln-triage: adding remediation: inventory stale accounts, rotate affected key with rewrap job, and schedule a compliance audit for KMS grants. Owner: security-team.

anika: will file a short blameless postmortem and add the runbook updates. Notifying CS with impacted tenant list. Closing thread once backfill finishes. :white_check_mark:
